messages:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from today's sync with Orchid Financial (trial customer) — verbatim quotes + asks. TL;DR: three feature asks, two UX pain points, one near-term win.

Maya (CS): Meeting notes:
- 'We lose users when search results take >1s to rerank.'
- 'Embeddings cost is ballooning; we need per-route chargeback or cheaper model options.'
- 'Would love an override to pin a model per-route for predictable latency.'

Maya (CS): Asks:
1) Per-route cost breakdown in Console (show embedding + generation tokenize) — P1
2) Model pinning per-route (UI + API) — P2
3) Quick toggle for reranking offload to cheaper model for long queries — P2

Priya (CSE): Do they have token volumes? any sample dataset? :thinking:

Maya (CS): They shared rough numbers: ~200k tokens/day across 3 routes, embeddings ~65% of cost. Said they can share redacted CSV — I'll follow up.

Arjun (Support): Recommend we open a billing data export ticket and attach the CSV. Also we can suggest embeddings quantization/cheaper model as immediate workaround.

Tomas (PM): Thanks — tagging product triage. Quick assessment:
- Per-route cost view: good discovery work, quick dashboard panel could be a 1-2 sprint effort
- Model pinning: needs infra + rollout plan, estimate 3-4 sprints
- Rerank toggle: maybe smaller, but requires runtime fallback logic
Can we get prioritization from CS + value/effort? I'll draft a spike for cost view.

Maya (CS): Prioritization request from Orchid: 1) cost visibility, 2) model pinning, 3) rerank toggle. They're willing to be a beta for cost view.

Nora (AE): Confirming Orchid would do beta, they'd need weekly check-ins for 6 weeks.

Priya (CSE): For the cost view spike: sample CSV would let us build a mock panel UI. Maya can you get the file?

Maya (CS): On it — asked customer to upload to secure S3 link by EOD.

Tomas (PM): I'll make a backlog ticket and link this thread. Action owners: Tomas -> spike for cost view; Priya -> mock UI with sample CSV once received; Arjun -> open billing export ticket; Maya -> collect CSV & coordinate beta.

Maya (CS): Thanks all. I'll update thread when I have the CSV. :thumbsup:

Arjun (Support): Created ticket S-1428 for billing export and assigned to BillingOps.

Tomas (PM): Added PROD-8123 (spike: per-route cost panel). Linked S-1428 and this thread.

Maya (CS): Last note from customer: 'If we can see per-route cost and pin the cheap model for search, we can convert to paid within 6 weeks.'

Nora (AE): Great, moving to account renewal playbook.

Priya (CSE): small sample of CSV they will send (from the call):
```
route,model,embeddings_tokens,gen_tokens,date
search,v1-embed,54000,12000,2026-03-20
inbox,v1-chat,12000,5000,2026-03-20
summarize,v1-embed,34000,8000,2026-03-20
```

Maya (CS): Thread update: CSV uploaded to S3 https://s.redwood.co/s/abcd (shared with Priya, Tomas, Arjun). I'll close the capture after beta kickoff.

Tomas (PM): Noted. Will post prioritization doc in ~48h.

Maya (CS): last_message: closing capture, moving to product triage. :white_check_mark:
